anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch) the two touch-electrode net labels NET0012 (U2 pin 57 / PB5) and NET0013 (U2 pin 59 / PB7) both terminate on the same node – the left terminal of the series resistor R6 (1 k) – together with the bottom plate of the 22 nF capacitor C16. The two TSC group pins are therefore shorted to each other and to the sampling capacitor on the resistor side, instead of forming two separate branches.
anomalies.expected: The specification defines these as two distinct nets: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor'. PB5 must connect to the electrode only through the series resistor, and PB7 must connect only to the sampling capacitor to GND; the two must not share a node.

evidence.quote: TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin "BTN" ... TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group
Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) block: NET0013 and NET0012 label boxes both wired into the left terminal of R6 (1k), with C16 (22n) hanging off that same node (root sheet, page 1)

anomalies.impact: The MCU's two Touch Sensing Controller group-2 pins are shorted together; the sampling capacitor is placed on the wrong node and the series resistor no longer isolates the electrode. Capacitive touch sensing on the button will not work (or will behave erratically).

anomalies.observed: On the root sheet the VBAT pin (U2 pin 19) carries an explicit no-connect marker (X) and is tied to nothing, while the adjacent VDD/VDDA pins are connected to VCC.
anomalies.expected: Standard practice for the STM32L4 family (and the spec's silence on this pin invites standard-practice judgement) is to tie VBAT to VDD when no coin cell / battery is fitted, so the backup domain is powered; leaving it floating is a deviation.

evidence.quote: U2 top edge: '19 VBAT' stub marked with a no-connect (X) symbol, separate from the VDD/VDDA/VCC junction (root sheet, page 1)
the schematic does not show where board VCC is normally sourced from (no battery, regulator, or USB part appears anywhere)

anomalies.impact: The MCU backup domain / VBAT supply is left unpowered; depending on the part this can cause the RTC to be unpowered, spurious current draw, or unreliable reset/boot behaviour.

parsed.summary: The NFC, display, reset and SWD wiring and all passive values match the specification, but the capacitive-touch block appears to merge the two TSC group-2 pins (PB5/NET0012 and PB7/NET0013) onto the same node at the series resistor, contradicting the spec's separate series-R and sampling-C topology; the VBAT pin is also left floating, which is against standard STM32L4 practice.
